fichas.title: Facility Management: Methods
fichas.summary: Facility management combines and optimizes building-related services for users and owners. A facility manager coordinates technical, commercial, infrastructure, and space functions, applying management methods such as scenario assessment, quality and risk management, mediation, and information design. The page also identifies factors that facility management can influence, including value, comfort, use, costs, impairment, and resource consumption.
uses: Improve user comfort, building function, and resource use
